_readme: The public CT cases used for every figure and for the reconstruction validation.
No DICOM and no clinical report is redistributed with this repository. Each case is
identified by the attributes a third party needs to retrieve exactly the same images
from TCIA: collection, subject ID, modality, series description and Series Instance
UID. See docs/REPRODUCING_FIGURES.md for step-by-step retrieval instructions.
No reference dose values are stored here. The published clinical data report is not
redistributed and is no longer read: the scanner behind these subjects is not in the
open coefficient table, so no reconstruction is made for them and there is nothing to
compare. These cases supply the figures only.
